63262-the-hoofs-of-pegasus.title: The Hoofs Of Pegasus
63262-the-hoofs-of-pegasus.creator: M. Letitia Stockett
63262-the-hoofs-of-pegasus.description: A book by M. Letitia Stockett. Last night I slid into the sea of sleep,  Translucent, cool and deep. I left my dusty self upon the sand  Like an old garment. Naked, free,  I felt the waves close over me;  The curious, eager water pressed  Against the white curve of my breast. Then deep, deep  Through the green depths I sank  Into the sea of sleep.

arxiv-2107-01731.title: Supporting decisions by unleashing multiple mindsets using pairwise comparisons method
arxiv-2107-01731.creator: Salvatore Greco, Sajid Siraj, Michele Lundy
arxiv-2107-01731.description: Abstract Inconsistency in pairwise comparison judgements is often perceived as an unwanted phenomenon and researchers have proposed a number of techniques to either reduce it or to correct it. We take a viewpoint that this inconsistency unleashes different mindsets of the decision maker(s) that should be taken into account when generating recommendations as decision support.

arxiv-2205-09442.title: Oracle-MNIST: a Realistic Image Dataset for Benchmarking Machine Learning Algorithms
arxiv-2205-09442.creator: Mei Wang, Weihong Deng
arxiv-2205-09442.description: Abstract We introduce the Oracle-MNIST dataset, comprising of 28 × \times 28 grayscale images of 30,222 ancient characters from 10 categories, for benchmarking pattern classification, with particular challenges on image noise and distortion. The training set totally consists of 27,222 images, and the test set contains 300 images per class.

arxiv-2212-14602.title: Influence of magnetic reconnection on the eruptive catastrophes of coronal magnetic flux ropes
arxiv-2212-14602.creator: Quanhao Zhang 1,2,3,∗ , Xin Cheng 4 , Rui Liu 2,3,5 , Anchuan Song 2,3,6 , Xiaolei Li 2,3,6 , and Yuming Wang 1,2,3
arxiv-2212-14602.description: Abstract 1 Large-scale solar eruptive activities have a close relationship with coronal magnetic flux ropes. Previous numerical studies have found that the equilibrium of a coronal flux rope system could be disrupted if the axial magnetic flux of the rope exceeds a critical value, so that the catastrophe occurs, initiating the flux rope to erupt.

arxiv-2403-04786.title: Breaking Down the Defenses: A Comparative Survey of Attacks on Large Language Models
arxiv-2403-04786.creator: Arijit Ghosh Chowdhury, Md Mofijul Islam, Vaibhav Kumar, Faysal Hossain Shezan, Vaibhav Kumar, Vinija Jain, Aman Chadha
arxiv-2403-04786.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a cornerstone in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), offering transformative capabilities in understanding and generating human-like text. However, with their rising prominence, the security and vulnerability aspects of these models have garnered significant attention.

arxiv-2502-17926.title: Fediverse Sharing: Cross-Platform Interaction Dynamics between Threads and Mastodon Users
arxiv-2502-17926.creator: Ujun Jeong, Alimohammad Beigi, Anique Tahir, Susan Xu Tang, H. Russell Bernard, Huan Liu
arxiv-2502-17926.description: Abstract Traditional social media platforms, once envisioned as digital town squares, now face growing criticism over corporate control, content moderation, and privacy concerns. Events such as Twitter’s acquisition (now X) and major policy changes have pushed users toward alternative platforms like Mastodon and Threads.

arxiv-2506-16914.title: Minimal Per-Flow Backlog Bounds at an Aggregate FIFO Server under Piecewise-Linear Arrival Curves
arxiv-2506-16914.creator: Lukas Wildberger, Anja Hamscher, Jens B. Schmitt
arxiv-2506-16914.description: Abstract Network Calculus (NC) is a versatile methodology based on min-plus algebra to derive worst-case per-flow performance bounds in networked systems with many concurrent flows. In particular, NC can analyze many scheduling disciplines; yet, somewhat surprisingly, an aggregate FIFO server is a notoriously hard case due to its min-plus non-linearity .

pmc-11289477.title: Genetic insights into serum cathepsins as diagnostic and therapeutic targets in knee and hip osteoarthritis
pmc-11289477.creator: Zhiqiang Shao, Hua Gao, Qinyi Han, Eryu Ning, Liting Sheng, Yuefeng Hao, Hui Che, Dan Hu, Chengqiang Wang
pmc-11289477.description: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a chronic disease due to the deterioration of cartilage structure and function, involving the progressive degradation of the cartilage extracellular matrix. Cathepsins, lysosomal cysteine proteases, play pivotal roles in various biological and pathological processes, particularly in protein degradation. Excess cathepsins levels are reported to contribute to the development of OA.

pmc-11676031.title: Descriptive Epidemiology of Soil-Transmitted Helminth Infections in the United States: Using Big Data to Characterize Patients and Analyze Parasitic Disease Trends
pmc-11676031.creator: Chad L Cross, Bryson Carrier, Miklo A A Alcala, Louisa A Messenger, Timothy G Geary
pmc-11676031.description: Soil-transmitted helminths (STH) include species responsible for hookworm disease, ascariasis, and trichuriasis. In the United States, STH infections have been greatly reduced with anthelmintic medications and improved hygiene and sanitation, however, cases still regularly occur, but limited epidemiological data exist. We investigated the occurrence of STH infections using big-data analytics of inpatient medical discharge records (1998–2020).

pmc-12471761.title: When a Woman’s Heart Fails to Contain: Takotsubo Syndrome as a Gendered Collapse of Emotional Regulation
pmc-12471761.creator: Giuseppe Marano, Enrico Romagnoli, Giuseppe Biondi-Zoccai, Gianandrea Traversi, Osvaldo Mazza, Roberto Pola, Eleonora Gaetani, Marianna Mazza, Luca Steardo
pmc-12471761.description: Background: Takotsubo Syndrome (TTS), or stress-induced cardiomyopathy, is an acute and typically reversible cardiac condition that mimics acute coronary syndrome without obstructive coronary artery disease. Predominantly affecting postmenopausal women, TTS has been increasingly recognized as a psychobiological disorder involving neuroendocrine dysregulation, autonomic imbalance, psychosocial stress, and gendered patterns of emotional regulation.

pmc-12610300.title: Screening of Cytotoxic and Genotoxic Activities of Subcritical Water Extracts from R. damascena and R. alba Flowers
pmc-12610300.creator: Tsvetelina Gerasimova, Svetla Gateva, Gabriele Jovtchev, Ana Dobreva, Milka Mileva, Zlatina Kokanova-Nedialkova, Milena Gospodinova, Tsveta Angelova, Paraskev Nedialkov, Claudio Ferrante
pmc-12610300.description: Regulatory changes in the EU for safety purposes require strict control and high safety standards for essential oils obtained by steam distillation, as they are classified as chemical mixtures with potential toxic effects. Subcritical water extracts (SWEs) are considered safer. This study evaluated the cytotoxicity and genotoxicity of SWEs from Rosa damascena Mill. and Rosa alba L.

pmc-12618902.title: Modelling response of Delottococcus aberiae (De lotto) male captures to pheromone emission rates
pmc-12618902.creator: Aitor Gavara, Manuel Zarzo, Javier Marzo Bargues, Sandra Vacas, Ismael Navarro Fuertes, Vicente Navarro‐Llopis
pmc-12618902.description: BACKGROUNDAn invasive mealybug from South Africa identified as Delottococcus aberiae (De Lotto) (Hemiptera: Pseudococcidae) is causing severe distortions and fruit size reduction in citrus areas of eastern Spain. The sex pheromone of this insect was recently identified and is being used as a powerful tool for pest monitoring and early detection purposes.
